dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Distinct, high-contrast white horizontal bars and spots arranged on a dark gray/black base across the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A small, high-contrast red rectangular patch located on the posterior crown, positioned above a small, distinct white patch.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A visible but diffuse boundary between the black crown and the solid gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent black-and-white transverse barring across the lower third of the visible dorsal surface.
